newsitem.title: USA: Halliburton set to complete reorganization.
newsitem.headline: Halliburton set to complete reorganization.

text.p: Halliburton Co said on Monday it planned to complete a reorganization of its legal structure under amended Delaware law by the end of 1996.

The company said it would create a new parent holding company, which will own the existing publicly held company and have the name Halliburton Co. The name of the former public company will be changed to Halliburton Energy Services Inc, the company said.

The reorganization is intended to improve internal operating flexibility and reduce the overall impact of certain state taxes, with the domestic energy services business units operating through subsidiary corporations rather than as divisions of the parent company.
Otherwise, Halliburton said the business operations of the company will not change as a result of the new legal structure and the reorganization will not require action by the company's shareholders.

The company said existing Halliburton common stock certificates will remain in force and effect, and no exchange of certificates will take place. The reorganization will be tax free to its shareholders, the company said.
